patterns.note: Work examples are presented in a dynamic grid layout, often using full-bleed imagery with minimal text overlays, creating a visually rich portfolio.
The brand name 'HELMUT' uses an extremely large, custom-cut, high-contrast display typeface that dominates the initial hero section and transforms on scroll.
A stark black and white base palette provides a sophisticated backdrop for vibrant, rich, and often saturated colors used within the showcased creative work.
The prominent 'HELMUT' logo dynamically transforms from a large, fixed element in the hero section to a smaller, integrated part of the sticky navigation bar as the user scrolls down.
The initial hero section features a background video or image that scrolls underneath the fixed logo, creating a subtle parallax-like effect before the logo transformation.
The primary content sections are dedicated to showcasing diverse creative campaigns, each presented as a large, clickable visual tile.

technique_notes: The site employs a smooth scrolling experience, likely using locomotive-scroll, which enhances the perception of depth and fluidity as content moves.
The hero section features a full-bleed video or image that scrolls independently of the main content, creating a layered visual effect.

A complex scroll-triggered animation transforms the hero logo: initially, it's a large, fixed element while content scrolls behind it; then, it shrinks and repositions to become a part of a sticky, solid-background navigation bar.

design_tokens.type_scale: An extremely oversized, custom-cut display font for the brand name (~10x body) contrasts with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and navigation.
design_tokens.spacing: The hero section is very airy with significant negative space, while the content grid maintains a balanced density with generous padding around elements.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its highly dynamic and transforming hero logo, which acts as a central visual anchor that evolves with scroll depth. The bold, full-bleed presentation of creative work, combined with a stark black and white base, creates a luxurious and editorial feel that elevates the agency's portfolio beyond typical marketing templates.
